description: Defines classes and templates for managing asynchronous protocol transactions, including transaction manager, transaction objects, and event sources/observers for handling transaction outcomes.

classes.name: protocol_transaction
classes.description: Represents a single asynchronous protocol transaction, providing methods to check status, retrieve response, and manage its lifecycle.

classes.name: protocol_transaction_manager
classes.description: Manages multiple concurrent protocol transactions, handling creation, response setting, and cancellation with timeout support.

classes.name: protocol_transaction_event_source
classes.description: Publishes transaction outcomes to subscribers, supporting setting results and cancellation.

classes.name: protocol_transaction_outcome_observer
classes.description: Observes transaction outcomes, allowing subscription and result inspection.

methods.name: create_transaction
methods.description: Creates a new protocol transaction with optional timeout, assigning a unique transaction ID.

methods.name: set_response
methods.description: Sets the response or outcome for a specific transaction ID.

methods.name: cancel_transaction
methods.description: Cancels a transaction by its ID, marking it as failed due to cancellation.

methods.name: subscribe_to
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to a transaction event source with a timeout.

methods.name: get_awaiter
methods.description: Returns an awaiter for asynchronous waiting on transaction completion.
